headline: Fluids resist movement but also enable it—understanding their behavior unlocks efficient navigation
universal_truth: Every medium has its physics; fighting the medium wastes energy; working with it multiplies effectiveness
fun_facts: Water is 800 times denser than air—moving through it requires far more energy
Dolphins can swim at 20+ mph by riding their own bow waves—using the water's physics to their advantage
Olympic swimmers shave their bodies because even tiny hair creates measurable drag
discussion_questions: What 'medium' are you moving through in your life?
Where are you fighting the environment versus working with it?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Swimming is harder than walking because water is denser than air. Every stroke fights drag. But the same water that resists you also supports you—you can float, you can push off it. The medium both opposes and enables.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: When moving through any medium—water, air, organizations, markets—you can fight the physics or work with it. Which approach wins?
cliff.prompt: How should you relate to your medium?

options.text: Understand the medium's properties and work with them—use its forces to your advantage rather than fighting its nature
options.response: Yes. Efficient swimmers work with water, not against it. They streamline, time strokes, use buoyancy. Fighting the medium wastes energy; understanding it multiplies effectiveness.
Effort matters, but efficiency matters more—smart beats hard...

q1.title: Drag and Resistance
q1.script: Fluids create drag—resistance that increases with speed. Moving twice as fast requires much more than twice the energy. Streamlining reduces drag; turbulence increases it. Shape matters as much as power.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Drag and Resistance"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Using the Medium
q2.script: Water resists movement, but it also enables propulsion. Swimmers push against water to move forward. The same medium that slows you also gives you something to push off. Resistance has uses.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Life Mediums
q3.script: You move through mediums too—organizational culture, market conditions, social norms. These have properties like fluids. You can fight them, or understand them and work with their nature.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Every medium has its physics. Fighting the medium wastes energy. Working with it multiplies effectiveness. Understand your environment.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 228. Tomorrow, we'll explore the human superpower—tools and leverage. Until then, notice what medium you're swimming through.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Medium Analysis - What Are You Swimming Through?
growTrack.learning_objective: Understand and work with environmental forces
growTrack.activity: What 'medium' are you navigating—an organization, a market, a social environment? What are its properties? Where are you fighting it versus working with it? Efficiency comes from understanding and using the medium's nature.
